visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a stop-motion sequence on a black surface. A robotic cat-like figure with golden ears and goggles pushes a white, television-headed robot into a sitting position against a vibrant blue and purple background. (2) Hands enter the frame to demonstrate the physical features of the television-headed robot. They open a small silver hatch on its chest and manipulate its joints. The scene cuts to a hands-on unboxing where a silver metal tin and clear plastic packaging are opened to reveal various robot components. (3) A series of close-up shots show a person's hands swapping the robot's hands, inserting a tiny metallic cassette tape into its chest, and plugging in a USB-C cable to show a blue glowing indicator light. (4) The final phase is a high-energy stop-motion animation of the television robot dancing and posing with a blue light stick alongside the cat-like robot, ending with a 25th-anniversary logo graphic overlay.

The music maintains a high BPM and optimistic major key. Short 'whoosh' transition sound effects are interspersed between musical phrases. (4) The track concludes with the chorus of the pop song swelling in volume, coinciding with the rhythmic stop-motion movements of the robots, ending on a final sustained synth note.
